scene_description: A family of four is camping outdoors in a wooded area. Two adults and two children are sitting around a round fire pit with a small fire. They are roasting marshmallows on sticks. A green tent is set up behind them, and blue camping chairs are visible. Trees surround the campsite.

questions.question: What do you see in this picture?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the middle of the picture — what is burning? What is set up behind the people?

questions.question: What are the people doing with their sticks?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what the people are holding and where the sticks are pointing.

questions.question: Where are the people sitting?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the trees and ground around the people.

questions.question: What is the tent used for when you go camping?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the tent behind the people — think about what you do inside a tent.

questions.question: What might happen next after the marshmallows are ready?
sample_answers: they take them off the stick
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the marshmallows on the sticks over the fire — what do people do after they roast food?

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever been camping or had a campfire?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you were outside at night or cooked food outside.
